name: lexmount-browser-global
description: Browse and automate websites from cloud workspaces with Skill, native CLI and device authorization.

interface.longDescription: Use Lexmount Global cloud browsers from Codex or ChatGPT cloud workspaces through a native CLI. Authorize on another device using a short code; the cloud workspace receives and privately stores its own credential. Open websites, inspect pages, fill forms and export screenshots or PDFs. Requires Linux x86_64, Python 3 and outbound HTTPS.
defaultPrompt: Open https://example.com, summarize the page and list its links.
Open https://www.selenium.dev/selenium/web/web-form.html, fill Text input with Browser test, verify it, and do not submit.

publication.release_notes: 4.0.0: Pure Skill and native CLI cloud edition. Device authorization uses separate start and poll commands that resume across conversation turns, with isolated Global credentials. Uses published CLI 1.5.0.
